rule.en:
**to be** has three forms in the present: **I am**, **he / she / it is**, **you / we / they are**. In speech they are short: **I'm**, **you're**, **he's**, **she's**, **it's**, **we're**, **they're**.

The negative adds **not**: **I'm not**, **isn't**, **aren't**: **It isn't cold.** A question puts the verb first: **Is it far?** **Are you ready?** Short answers: **Yes, I am.** / **No, it isn't.** (never *Yes, I'm*).

English never drops the subject, not even it: **It's cold.** **It's late.**

Age takes be: **I'm ten** (not *I have ten years*). So do many feelings where other languages say have: **I'm cold**, **I'm hot**, **I'm hungry**, **I'm thirsty**, and **I'm right**. But **I've got a cold** means you are ill.
rule.sl:
**to be** (biti) ima v sedanjiku tri oblike: **I am**, **he / she / it is**, **you / we / they are**. V govoru so kratke: **I'm**, **you're**, **he's**, **she's**, **it's**, **we're**, **they're**.

Zanikanje doda **not**: **I'm not**, **isn't**, **aren't**: **It isn't cold.** (Ni mrzlo.) V vprašanju gre glagol na začetek: **Is it far?** (Je daleč?) **Are you ready?** Kratki odgovori: **Yes, I am.** / **No, it isn't.** (nikoli *Yes, I'm*).

Osebek nikoli ne odpade, niti it: **It's cold.** (Mraz je.) **It's late.** (Pozno je.)

Starost gre z be: **I'm ten** (star sem deset let; ne *I have ten years*, čeprav slovensko rečemo tudi imam deset let). Z be so tudi mnoga počutja, kjer slovenščina reče drugače: **I'm cold** (zebe me), **I'm hot** (vroče mi je), **I'm hungry** (lačen sem), **I'm thirsty** (žejen sem) in **I'm right** (imam prav). Toda **I've got a cold** pomeni, da si prehlajen.
rule.it:
**to be** (essere) al presente ha tre forme: **I am**, **he / she / it is**, **you / we / they are**. Parlando si accorciano: **I'm**, **you're**, **he's**, **she's**, **it's**, **we're**, **they're**.

La negazione aggiunge **not**: **I'm not**, **isn't**, **aren't**: **It isn't cold.** (Non fa freddo.) Nella domanda il verbo va all'inizio: **Is it far?** (È lontano?) **Are you ready?** Risposte brevi: **Yes, I am.** / **No, it isn't.** (mai *Yes, I'm*).

Il soggetto non si omette mai, nemmeno it: **It's cold.** (Fa freddo.) **It's late.** (È tardi.)

Dove l'italiano usa avere, l'inglese usa spesso be. L'età: **I'm ten** (ho dieci anni; mai *I have ten years*). Le sensazioni: **I'm cold** (ho freddo), **I'm hot** (ho caldo), **I'm hungry** (ho fame), **I'm thirsty** (ho sete), e **I'm right** (ho ragione). Ma **I've got a cold** vuol dire «ho il raffreddore».
rule.de:
**to be** (sein) hat im Präsens drei Formen: **I am**, **he / she / it is**, **you / we / they are**. Gesprochen sind sie kurz: **I'm**, **you're**, **he's**, **she's**, **it's**, **we're**, **they're**.

Die Verneinung bekommt **not**: **I'm not**, **isn't**, **aren't**: **It isn't cold.** (Es ist nicht kalt.) In der Frage steht das Verb vorn: **Is it far?** (Ist es weit?) **Are you ready?** Kurze Antworten: **Yes, I am.** / **No, it isn't.** (nie *Yes, I'm*).

Wie im Deutschen fällt das Subjekt nie weg, auch nicht es: **It's cold.** (Es ist kalt.) **It's late.**

Das Alter wie im Deutschen mit be: **I'm ten** (nie *I have ten years*). Und auch wo das Deutsche haben oder mir ist sagt, steht oft be: **I'm cold** (mir ist kalt), **I'm hot** (mir ist heiß), **I'm hungry** (ich habe Hunger), **I'm thirsty** (ich habe Durst) und **I'm right** (ich habe recht). Aber **I've got a cold** heißt »ich bin erkältet«.

note.en: How you feel takes be: I'm cold, not I have cold.
note.sl: Počutje gre z be: I'm cold, ne I have cold.
note.it: Le sensazioni vanno con be: I'm cold, non I have cold.
note.de: Das Befinden steht mit be: I'm cold, nicht I have cold.

note.en: Age takes be: is ten, not has ten years.
note.sl: Starost gre z be: is ten, ne has ten years.
note.it: L'età va con be: is ten, non has ten years.
note.de: Das Alter steht mit be: is ten, nicht has ten years.

examples.en: Are you hungry, Alfie? — Yes, I am!

note.en: A short answer keeps the full form: Yes, I am (never Yes, I'm).
note.sl: Kratki odgovor ima polno obliko: Yes, I am (nikoli Yes, I'm).
note.it: La risposta breve ha la forma intera: Yes, I am (mai Yes, I'm).
note.de: Die Kurzantwort hat die volle Form: Yes, I am (nie Yes, I'm).

examples.it: La locanda Packhorse Inn non è lontana.
examples.de: Das Gasthaus Packhorse Inn ist nicht weit.

examples.en: We're at home and the dogs are in the garden.
examples.sl: Smo doma, psi pa so na vrtu.
examples.it: Siamo a casa e i cani sono in giardino.
examples.de: Wir sind zu Hause, und die Hunde sind im Garten.

examples.en: Excuse me, are you Mrs Hartley?
examples.it: Mi scusi, è Lei la signora Hartley?

note.en: you is the same for a friend, for a stranger and for many people.
note.sl: you je enak za ti, za vi in za vikanje.
note.it: you vale per tu, per voi e per Lei.
note.de: you steht für du, für ihr und für Sie.

note.en: Being right takes be: you're right.
note.sl: Imeti prav je v angleščini be: you're right.
note.it: Avere ragione in inglese si dice con be: you're right.
note.de: Recht haben heißt auf Englisch be: you're right.
